name: Ascendant
defines: The sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth: your outward manner, first impression, and the way you meet anything new. It depends on the exact minute of birth more than any other point.

aries.definition: You arrive at speed. The first thing people register about you is energy and directness, whatever is going on underneath.
aries.showsUp: You walk fast and speak plainly, you volunteer before you have thought it through, and people read you as braver than you feel.

taurus.definition: You arrive calmly. People find you steady and unhurried, with a physical presence that settles a room rather than stirring it.
taurus.showsUp: You are slow to be flustered, you speak in an even register, and people assume you are more relaxed about things than you are.

gemini.definition: You arrive talking. The first impression is quick, curious and sociable — you make contact through conversation before anything else.
gemini.showsUp: You ask questions to break the ice, you seem younger than you are, and people read you as lighter than you actually are.

cancer.definition: You arrive carefully. People meet a gentle, watchful manner, and you take a while to come out from behind it.
cancer.showsUp: You are warm but guarded with strangers, you deflect questions about yourself, and people find you approachable long before they find you knowable.

leo.definition: You arrive noticeably. There is a warmth and a presentation to how you present yourself that makes you memorable on first meeting.
leo.showsUp: You dress and carry yourself with some deliberateness, you are generous with your attention, and people remember meeting you.

virgo.definition: You arrive observing. People meet someone precise, modest and slightly reserved, taking the measure of things before joining in.
virgo.showsUp: You are neat and understated, you ask practical questions, and people underestimate you until they see you work.

libra.definition: You arrive pleasantly. The first impression is graceful and accommodating; you meet people halfway before they have asked you to.
libra.showsUp: You are easy to talk to and hard to read, you avoid saying the disagreeable thing, and people find you charming before they find you clear.

scorpio.definition: You arrive guarded. People sense there is more going on than you are showing, and they are right.
scorpio.showsUp: You give away little at first, you hold eye contact longer than most, and people find you either compelling or unsettling with very little middle ground.

sagittarius.definition: You arrive open. The first impression is friendly, frank and a little larger than the situation calls for.
sagittarius.showsUp: You are quick to laugh and quick to say the honest thing, and people read you as more casual about consequences than you are.

capricorn.definition: You arrive composed. People meet someone contained and capable, and they tend to assume you are in charge.
capricorn.showsUp: You are formal with strangers, sparing with your reactions, and read as older and more serious than you are — which reverses as you get older.

aquarius.definition: You arrive at a slight angle. People register something distinctive about you and a friendliness that keeps its distance.
aquarius.showsUp: You are sociable without being intimate, you say the unexpected thing, and people find you interesting before they find you close.

pisces.definition: You arrive softly. Your edges are indistinct on first meeting, and people project a good deal onto you.
pisces.showsUp: You adapt to whoever you are with, you are hard for people to pin down, and different people describe you quite differently.
